entities.name: PDU session authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure to enable the DN to authenticate and/or authorize the upper layers of the UE when establishing a PDU session, re-authenticate after establishment, or authenticate 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE upon REMOTE UE REPORT message.

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message used to transport EAP-request message from network to UE as part of PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message used to transport EAP-response message from UE to network as part of PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message used to transport EAP-success message when authentication succeeds during UE-requested PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: Message used to transport EAP-failure message when authentication fails during UE-requested PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT
entities.description: Message used to transport EAP-success message when authentication succeeds after PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Message used to transport EAP-failure message when authentication fails after PDU session establishment.

entities.name: EAP-request message
entities.description: EAP message type sent from network to UE to initiate authentication challenge.

entities.name: EAP-response message
entities.description: EAP message type sent from UE to network in response to EAP-request.

entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP message type indicating successful authentication.

entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP message type indicating failed authentication.

entities.name: T3590
entities.description: Timer started when PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND is sent and stopped when corresponding PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE is received.

entities.name: Non-emergency PDU session condition
entities.description: Condition that PDU session authentication and authorization procedure can only be performed during or after UE-requested PDU session procedure establishing a non-emergency PDU session.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
Procedure includes receiving PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.
PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message carries EAP-request message.
PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message carries EAP-response message.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message carries EAP-success message during establishment.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message carries EAP-failure message during establishment.
PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message carries EAP-success message after establishment.
PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message carries EAP-failure message after establishment.
Sending PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND starts timer T3590.
Receiving PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE stops timer T3590.
Procedure requires non-emergency PDU session condition to be satisfied.
